text:
maria: Quick standup — we need final hero copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, a short benchmark blurb for the landing, and webinar gating. two-week push?
aj: yep. target webinar next Wed 10am PT, pre-launch post 48h prior.
noah: will ship 3 hero variants in Figma by Fri AM. lightweight frames only.
sam: will pull p95 latency + $/1k tokens and a 1-paragraph benchmark blurb.
tess: I'll scaffold the webinar page and HubSpot form. confirm routing: mode hidden field -> hosted/inbound, dedicated/ae, private/ae+se.
maria: correct. also add utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch and gate latency-playbook.pdf on reg. default hero = Hosted if mode missing.
aj: CTA options to test: "Get started — Hosted" vs "Try Hosted now"; similar pattern for Dedicated/Private.
noah: hero subhead idea: "One API. Choose your SLA." short and punchy.
sam: benchmark blurb (draft): "In our benchmarks, Dedicated delivers consistent p95 latency under sustained load while Hosted offers rapid scale at lower startup cost — see the latency playbook for numbers."
tess: form snippet: <input type="hidden" name="mode" value="hosted">. HubSpot pseudo: if(mode=='hosted') tag='inbound_hosted' else if(mode=='dedicated') tag='ae_dedicated' else tag='ae_private'.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window Wed 08:00 PT. assets to /releases/marketing by Tue 18:00 PT.
maria: Action items: noah Figma (Fri), sam benchmark blurb + CSV (Thu), tess page + workflow (Mon), aj social + post copy (Mon). reconvene Wed 09:00 PT for go/no-go. :rocket:
